brief: A 1980s single-storey island grocery: a long low building of tan vertical siding under a grey gabled roof with a deep front porch roof on posts, a brown board sign lettered 'ISLAND MARKET' along the fascia, golf carts and cars parked in front, an ATM sign. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Kelleys Island Market (Lake Erie island, OH, c.1985): a one-storey grocery under a big gable roof, board-and-batten walls over a brick wainscot, a bracketed shingled canopy along the front with a little gable over the door, painted signs ('ISLAND MARKET', 'FRESH MEATS', 'BEER WINE'), an ATM; golf carts and a car with kayaks

why.note: an island resort's grocery built barn-like to match the village
